prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. Torrents of rain pour from black clouds onto a valley of low black goat-hair tents, tiny dark silhouettes in hooded ankle-length robes of rough brown wool, barefoot running between the tents, a fork of lightning splitting the sky and lighting the whole valley. The tents are dark inside. Night, lightning and sheets of water. Overwhelming and loud. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
